text: Professional OverviewThis major was established to meet the demands of the development of civil aircraft and other aviation vehicles in our country. It mainly studies the structural design, structural strength analysis, verification of design compliance and compliance verification technology of military aircraft and civil aircraft. It is based on mechanics as the theoretical foundation and involves multiple disciplines related to mechanics such as material mechanics, thin-walled structure mechanics, and aerodynamics. At the same time, it combines the actual needs of aircraft structure design, and is a distinctive applied discipline.Training ObjectivesIt usually aims to cultivate comprehensive and innovative senior specialized talents with a solid foundation in aerospace disciplines, proficient in systematic airworthiness certification and management knowledge, advanced compliance verification technologies, and good professional ethics and social responsibility. They can work in the military and civil aviation fields, engaging in aircraft structure design, airworthiness certification, compliance verification and verification, and full life cycle safety management.
